fix: register document touchmove listener as non-passive during drag (#303)

Browsers treat document-level touch listeners as passive by default, so preventDefault() in onDragMove was ignored and the page scrolled while dragging the handle on touch devices (reported via ant-design/ant-design#59618). The listener only exists while a drag is in progress, so { passive: false } does not affect normal
